articles.title: Our go-to earbuds for taking calls have fallen to their lowest price to date
articles.summary: The Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro have an excellent microphone, impressive ANC, and a charging case with a screen. They’re also on sale for $129.99 for Black Friday.
articles.body: If you’re looking for a new pair of earbuds, the Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro are on sale for $129.99 at Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart right now. That’s the lowest price we’ve seen for Anker’s excellent wireless earbuds, which normally retail for $169.99 and come in four colors (black, white, blue, and pink) all of which are discounted through November 30th as part of Anker’s ongoing Black Friday promo. [Product: Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro | While the Liberty 5 Pro have a number of great features — including support LDAC for high-res audio and an IP55 dust and water resistance rating — the call quality is what stands out. The microphone does an impressive job cutting out background noise, and my colleague John Higgins praised the Liberty 5 Pro for filtering out emergency vehicles, arborists cutting tree branches, and even loud children. The active noise cancellation is excellent, which helps when you’re trying to hear someone on the other end of the phone whose earbuds aren’t as clear as yours. The charging case also features a handy 0.96-inch screen, so you can adjust the ANC and sound profile on the fly. Read our Anker Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro review.

articles.title: Amazon’s first digital photo frame is up to 50 percent off for Black Friday
articles.summary: The Alexa Photo Frame is on sale starting at $114.99 ($115 off) for Black Friday, which is the first sizable discount we’ve seen on the 10-inch digital frame.
articles.body: Amazon only announced its first digital photo frame less than a month ago, but it’s already getting a sizable discount for Black Friday. You can currently grab the Alexa Photo Frame at Amazon and Best Buy starting at $114 ($115 off), making it a great holiday gift for anyone who loves displaying family photos. If you prefer the walnut trim over the birch or standard black models, it’s also on sale at Best Buy for $134.99 ($95 off) — which, like with the others, is the first discount we’ve seen. [Product: Amazon Alexa Photo Frame | The Alexa Photo Frame features a 10-inch, semi-matte touchscreen that’s designed to make digital photos look more natural, with built-in light sensors that automatically adjust brightness throughout the day. It displays images from Amazon Photos, which supports uploads from both iOS and Android devices, including photos stored in iCloud. You can choose which people or albums to display, or let Alexa Plus do the work, which often results in photos based on your facial expression, the season, and even the lighting. You can also search for specific photos with voice commands, letting you easily pull up images of your first dog, your child as a baby, and other shots without having to scroll endlessly through years of photos yourself. If you want to add a more personal touch, Amazon also lets you attach voice notes to individual photos via the Amazon Photos app. For example, you can add a recording of your kid explaining their Halloween costume to a trick-or-treating photo. Plus, you can preload the frame with photos and recordings before gifting it, so your loved one won’t have to spend time setting it up. We’re still testing Amazon’s answer to the Aura frame, but it looks like a particularly good option if you’re already an Amazon Prime member. A Prime subscription grants you unlimited full-resolution photo storage and access to Alexa Plus at no additional cost, and unlike Amazon’s smart displays, the frame doesn’t serve up annoying ads. That said, you don’t need a subscription to use it, and new users can always access a limited-time trial of Alexa Plus.

articles.title: Elon Musk got really awkward at Tesla’s Argentina launch.
articles.summary:
The CEO joined the live event via video in Buenos Aires, with President Javier Milei on stage, only to immediately freeze up, make exaggerated facial expressions, and repeat, “I don’t really know what I want to say,” for about two minutes before hanging up.
